summary: The open issues ordered in release waves by distance from tree-sitter: each wave bumps the packages it names, and the exact-pin cascade carries the bump to everything downstream. Waves 0 to 2 and the CLI hardening landed (#43-#70): the gate is green, compiler and sdk carry #7, #9, #17 and the DA00-09 lints, and the cli refuses unknown options everywhere.

waves.name: Wave 4 — guide/teach inside a handler, at the grammar
waves.goal: guide or teach placed inside an on intent/on offtopic handler gets one error at the statement, with tree-sitter, parser-dsl and the linter agreeing, and DA00-09 amended to record it.

items.note: Grammar first. The lints DA00-09 asked for landed in #68 (W012 extended to guide/teach, W017 a second interact, W018 statements after a transition); guide/teach inside an on intent/on offtopic handler still reports a generic E004. A precise error needs tree-sitter-behavior to admit guide/teach in a handler body so parser-dsl and the linter can refuse it at the exact position — an amendment to ADR DA00-09 and a cascade from tree-sitter down. A linter reading the raw text of the parse ERROR node was built and rejected in review (false positive on a valid state-level guide, hid the real error, missed 128 of 192 placements).

waves.name: Wave 3 — language-server debt
waves.goal: Merge-graph resolution lives in one place in the language server, with a decision recorded on multi-root workspaces.

items.note: Three call sites: features/diagnostics.js:66/86/89/109 and server.js:185-186, no cache, no multi-root. Refactor with no visible symptom; the language server is a leaf.
